SELECT u.id, u.username, u.avatar, u.last_active_at, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_note_item n WHERE n.user_id = u.id AND n.is_deleted = 0), 0) AS noteCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_main_link m WHERE m.user_id = u.id) > 0 AS hasMainLink FROM t_user u WHERE u.status = 1
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY u.last_active_at DESC
